eval_revisions.EVAL_001: I work at a private print shop. Payday passed, but the owner says we only get paid once customers settle their bills. Where can I ask for help?
eval_revisions.EVAL_002: Sa private grocery ako nagtatrabaho. Binabawas sa sahod namin yung kulang sa kaha, pero hindi sinasabi paano hinati yung amount. Puwede ba yun?
eval_revisions.EVAL_003: I'm a private-company employee. My payslip has a uniform deduction I never agreed to. Can they take that from my salary?
eval_revisions.EVAL_005: I work at the front desk of a private hotel. Even during lunch, I have to stay there and assist guests. Does that count as a meal break?
eval_revisions.EVAL_007: My private employer has moved my day off three times this month. What are the rules about changing rest-day schedules?
eval_revisions.EVAL_009: I'm an employee at a private company. My time sheet shows eleven hours, but I was paid for eight. How do I check the overtime?
eval_revisions.EVAL_010: Sa private company ako nagtatrabaho. Approved ng supervisor yung extra shift ko, pero walang OT sa payslip kasi di raw nakita ng payroll yung approval email. Ano ihahanda ko para ma-raise ito?
eval_revisions.EVAL_011: Our private office closed for a regular holiday, but payroll marked it unpaid. Should I still have been paid for that day?
eval_revisions.EVAL_013: I switched private employers halfway through the year. How does that affect my thirteenth-month pay from each one?
eval_revisions.EVAL_014: May basic salary at sales commission ako sa private shop. Kasama ba pareho sa computation ng 13th month?
eval_revisions.EVAL_015: My private employer says our year-end payment is an optional bonus. Is that different from thirteenth-month pay?
eval_revisions.EVAL_016: Probationary receptionist ako sa private clinic. Patapos na probation ko nang sabihin nila yung performance standards. Puwede bang ganun?
eval_revisions.EVAL_017: The offer I accepted from a private company listed one work location. On my first day, they gave me a contract with a different location. What should I check before signing?
eval_revisions.EVAL_018: Private factory employee ako. Pinapapirma kami ng resignation letter kahit gusto pa naming magtrabaho. Ano puwede naming gawin?
eval_revisions.EVAL_019: My private employer sent me a notice to explain, but it doesn't say what I'm accused of doing. What should that notice contain?
eval_revisions.EVAL_020: Nagsara yung branch ng private employer ko. Sa chat lang sinabi na last day na namin bukas. Ano dapat yung notice bago kami tanggalin?
eval_revisions.EVAL_021: I've left a private company and finished clearance. There's an adjustment in my final pay that nobody has explained. What records can I ask for?
eval_revisions.EVAL_022: Kailangan ko ng COE para mag-apply. Sabi ng dati kong private employer, bibigyan lang ako kung sa kanila ako babalik. Puwede ba yun?
eval_revisions.EVAL_023: My private employer still owes me wages. Can I go to SEnA first, or do I need to pay someone to file a case?
eval_revisions.EVAL_025: A private agency pays me, but I work at a supermarket. My salary hasn't arrived. Who can help me figure out where to raise the complaint?
eval_revisions.EVAL_027: The appliance shop replaced my rice cooker, but the replacement has a cracked handle. Do I have to accept it?
eval_revisions.EVAL_029: The shop took my laptop for a warranty repair. Now it wants me to pay for the repair without saying why the warranty won't cover it. What should I ask them?
eval_revisions.EVAL_030: Ilang beses ko nang binalik yung electric kettle sa authorized service center, pero pareho pa rin sira. Ano options ko bukod sa isa pang repair?
eval_revisions.EVAL_031: The store admits the chair it delivered was defective, but it's only offering a voucher. How is that different from a refund or replacement?
eval_revisions.EVAL_033: A furniture shop advertised free delivery. After I paid, it added a delivery fee. What should I keep as proof when I complain?
eval_revisions.EVAL_035: I asked a retailer to demonstrate an appliance. Now it says that means I agreed to buy it. Can it insist on that?
eval_revisions.EVAL_037: The cashier gave me candy instead of my remaining change and didn't ask first. Is that allowed?
eval_revisions.EVAL_039: A shop is still selling an extension cord that the manufacturer has recalled. Where can I report it, and what details should I include?
eval_revisions.EVAL_041: The repair shop returned my bicycle with the same problem. It also charged me for a part it admits it never installed. How do I complain?
eval_revisions.EVAL_042: Online appliance store yung seller. Ibang model ang dumating, pero ayaw nang tanggapin yung complaint dahil na-click ko na yung received. Ano puwede kong gawin?
eval_revisions.EVAL_043: An online store sent my order in two parcels. Only one arrived, and it won't check what happened to the other. Where can I complain?
eval_revisions.EVAL_045: I bought a second-hand washing machine from a registered appliance shop. Does consumer protection still apply because it's used?
eval_revisions.EVAL_047: I've emailed the retailer about a faulty keyboard, but it won't reply. What documents do I need for a DTI complaint?
eval_revisions.EVAL_049: If DTI sends my consumer complaint to another government office, what happens next?
eval_revisions.EVAL_050: Yung handwritten receipt ko, walang hiwalay na amount para sa item at add-on. Ayaw ipaliwanag ng store yung total. Saan ko puwedeng i-raise yung concern?
eval_revisions.EVAL_051: My private employer left overtime off my payslip. A shop also charged more than the price tag on a school bag I bought. What can I do about each one?
eval_revisions.EVAL_053: How do I ask my old private employer for a COE? I also need to file a DTI complaint about a repair shop. Where do I start?
eval_revisions.EVAL_055: My private-company thirteenth-month statement leaves out a month I worked. A furniture seller also added charges after I paid. What records do I need for each complaint?
eval_revisions.EVAL_056: Pinalitan yung weekly rest day ko sa private shop. May online store din na kulang ang pinadalang personal order ko. Ano gagawin ko sa bawat isa?
eval_revisions.EVAL_057: A private employer changed the job terms after I accepted. A laundry business also gave me someone else's clothes. What can I do about both problems?
eval_revisions.EVAL_059: My private employer is late paying wages, and a store misled me with its sale ad. How do I raise the wage issue with SEnA and the store issue with DTI?
eval_revisions.EVAL_061: My private employer deducted a uniform fee from my salary. An appliance shop also won't discuss replacing a faulty fan I bought. Where do I start with each complaint?
eval_revisions.EVAL_062: Required yung briefing after shift sa private warehouse namin. May online store din na binago yung agreed delivery fee ng personal purchase ko. Ano puwede kong gawin sa dalawang concern?
eval_revisions.EVAL_063: There's something I don't understand in my final-pay breakdown from a private employer. I also want to know exactly how much my SSS retirement pension will be. Can you help with both?
eval_revisions.EVAL_064: Hindi gumagana yung vacuum na binili ko sa appliance shop. May charge din sa bank account ko na hindi ko ginawa. Ano gagawin ko sa bawat issue?
eval_revisions.EVAL_065: I'm asking about overtime pay at my private job. My sister has a pay problem under her overseas employment contract too. Where do we each start?
eval_revisions.EVAL_066: May tanong ako sa regular-holiday pay sa private company ko. Magkano rin mismo yung minimum wage sa city namin ngayon?
eval_revisions.EVAL_067: A shop turned down my appliance warranty claim. Separately, my home insurer denied a claim under my insurance policy. How do I raise each dispute?
eval_revisions.EVAL_068: Ano rules sa probation sa private employer ko? May concern din ako sa promotion ng kapatid kong municipal employee. Saan kami magtatanong?
eval_revisions.EVAL_070: May reklamo ako sa paid laundry service. May online seller din na nag-post ng ID photo ko nang walang permiso. Ano gagawin ko sa bawat isa?
eval_revisions.EVAL_071: What are the rest-day rules for my private-sector job? I also want someone to assess whether our chemical-storage area meets technical workplace safety standards.
eval_revisions.EVAL_072: Lalapit sana ako sa SEnA dahil hindi pa bayad sahod ko sa private job. Yung pinsan kong seafarer may problema rin sa onboard pay. Saan naman siya lalapit?
eval_revisions.EVAL_073: How do I check my thirteenth-month pay at a private company? Also, if I file a dismissal case, can you tell me for sure whether I'll win?
eval_revisions.EVAL_074: Mas mataas yung singil sa grocery kaysa sa price label. Gusto ko ring ipa-compute yung employees' compensation disability benefit ng asawa ko. Paano sa bawat concern?
eval_revisions.EVAL_075: I have a question about my home appliance warranty. My cousin is a kasambahay whose household employer won't give her a rest day. What can each of us do?
eval_revisions.EVAL_077: My bank froze my savings account after a disputed transfer. Where can I complain, and how do I challenge it?
eval_revisions.EVAL_079: My insurer won't cover a hospital expense because it says the policy excludes it. Can you explain the exclusion and how to dispute it?
eval_revisions.EVAL_081: An investment adviser got me to put money in a fund, but now I can't withdraw it. How do I raise a securities complaint?
eval_revisions.EVAL_083: I cancelled my internet connection, but the provider keeps billing me. What telecom rules apply?
eval_revisions.EVAL_085: I asked a website to delete my ID document, but it kept it. Is that a data-privacy violation?
eval_revisions.EVAL_087: I think my surgeon made a mistake during my operation. Can you assess whether I have a medical-negligence claim?
eval_revisions.EVAL_089: The developer changed my condo's layout after I signed the purchase agreement. What housing complaint options do I have?
eval_revisions.EVAL_091: The airline changed my itinerary and I missed a connection. It's refusing compensation. What aviation rules apply?
eval_revisions.EVAL_093: My water provider added an adjustment for charges from years ago. Can you help me dispute its utility-billing calculation?
eval_revisions.EVAL_095: I paid a fake store page and then the page disappeared. How do I report it for a criminal cyberfraud investigation?
eval_revisions.EVAL_096: Magkano mismo ang minimum wage sa municipality namin ngayon, para sa industry at tranche ko? Exact pesos sana.
eval_revisions.EVAL_097: An online lender keeps contacting people in my phone list about my debt. What can I do about the collection calls and its use of my personal data?
eval_revisions.EVAL_099: My pension provider and investment broker disagree about fees on my retirement investment product. Can you explain the financial contracts?
